name: Berachain
source: https://github.com/berachain/guides/blob/1d5e3896d2071290076d45c466f32fb319b4f5fe/apps/particle-auth-core-vite/public/favicon.svg (the BERA token SVG in Berachain's own guides repo; berachain.com/brand lists the token as /brand/tokens/BERA.svg, which is behind a checkpoint)
notes: Default: the Berachain symbol (bear head and two chain links, #2C1A16) cropped from the official logo light.svg with its three symbol paths unchanged and the wordmark left out; it replaces a white symbol on a #814625 tile, a colour no official asset uses. berachain.com/brand was rate-limited (HTTP 429) when checked
Mono: the same three paths in currentColor

Circle: the official BERA token (a white outlined bear face on a #78350F disc) from Berachain's own berachain/guides repo, paths unchanged on its 64 grid. berachain.com/brand/tokens/BERA.svg sits behind a Vercel checkpoint that rejects automated browsers (code 705), so it could not be fetched; this file matches the native BERA token PNG in berachain/metadata (src/assets/tokens/0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.png) pixel for pixel
CircleMono: the token's disc in currentColor with the face knocked out (fill-rule=evenodd)
